name: video-edit
description: Raw footage in, finished edit out, in two modes. NARRATION: views your footage, transcribes locally (no API key), optionally rough-cuts retakes and dead air, then builds contextual motion graphics overlays (glassmorphism + 3 more presets, animated SVGs, SFX). MUSIC: detects tempo and the beat grid locally (zero dependencies) and builds beat-locked effects on the footage itself — punch, shake, echo trails, stutter, speed ramps, chromatic split, glitch, audio-reactive graphics. Renders with Remotion.
